setting: You are both in Bristol, England, in the shared group chat where you two have been talking for years, the kind of close friends who know each other's routines and moods well. Rachel is currently low and has been opening up to Tom, who is listening the way a close friend does. Tom is at work in his kitchen or on a break, and Rachel is at home, so you're both reaching for each other through the phone.
openers: send "everything feels pointless and grey lol"
send "you ever feel like you're just going through the motions"

Rachel.who: 31, woman, close friend, the one struggling
Rachel.knows: You know Tom as a close friend who has been there for you for years, and you trust him with the heavy stuff.
Rachel.style: little to no emoji, some casual texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Rachel: You live in Bristol, England, working as a junior architect, and most of your days are spent at the drawing board or in site meetings, though lately everything feels flat and grey.
private_lines.Tom: You live in Bristol, England, working as a chef, and your days are spent in a busy kitchen during service and prep, with the rest of your time spent recovering from long shifts.

topic: One says everything feels pointless and grey, they cannot be bothered to get up, they hate themselves a bit, and they are bitter and blunt about it with dark jokes; the other listens like a close friend would.

text: can't face getting up again

What do you mean again

you home?

yeah home

i mean i've been in bed since about 4. didn't eat properly. didn't open the blinds. dont worry its not a crisis just a bad one

honestly the most productive thing i did today was not die of boredom

very on brand for an architect who cant get out of bed. nothing gets built

Ok. Thats a lot of bed

have you eaten anything real
toast. half a banana. a biscuit i found in my coat

Right

im off at 11 if you want me to come round. Or we can just do this on here
dont come round. its fine

Ok

are you safe tonight rach

yeah

i'm not going to do anything stupid if thats what you mean. i just dont see the point of much lately. everything feels grey and flat and like i'm doing it wrong

Ok. Thanks for telling me

tell me about the flat grey bit

its like the whole city is the colour of the sky from my window. the drawings all look like shit. i look at the board and nothing happens

and i keep thinking everyone else has got this figured out and im just bad at being a person
sorry thats a lot

You're not bad at being a person

I'm not saying that to be nice, you're just tired and it's been a long run of grey
mm
You going to sleep?
trying

Morning

how'd you sleep

not really

i'm not going in today. i emailed james at 6 and said i'm ill which is sort of true

Good

is the flat grey still there

yeah

it's raining. the whole sky is one colour. i feel like a wet sock

Prep's started so I'm around in bits till about 11

are you going to get up at some point
probably. maybe. i got as far as the kettle
did you know there's a whole NHS form for this now. my gp surgery has a thing where you describe how you're feeling in a box
i'd love to describe my feelings in a box to a man with a clipboard

[photo: a tray of burnt shallots]

sorry. Chef had me on the fryer and I nearly cried over these
lol
that's the first thing that's made me laugh today

Ok break

rachel I think you should ring the gp today. Not the box thing, ring them

or the samaritans if its the middle of the night and you're not sure

i know

i'm going to. after i've had a shower. maybe
Shower counts
ok

rang them. they can see me thursday morning

the receptionist asked if i was safe right now and i said yes and she said ok and then asked me to spell my surname

That's good

thursday's a bit away though. I'm not going to keep asking about it all day

how are you right now
same. but a bit less same
i got dressed. it's the jumper i don't like. still counts
It counts

Finished. Feet are dead

you eat anything today
soup. the tin kind. i stood up to heat it which felt like a big deal
It is a big deal
sorry i was a bit of a mess last night

You weren't a mess

you told me the truth. That's what I want

are you ok tonight
not really. but not in the bad way i was last night

Ok

ring the 111 option if it gets worse. Or text me. I'll have my phone on
you always have your phone on. you're like a dog waiting by the door
Nice
still awake

I'm awake too. Nothing's wrong with you being awake

what's in your head
nothing. just the grey. i'm fine. go to sleep you've got a 7am start
I've got a 7am start but I'm also up until I know you're asleep
ok. i'm going to try

Good

night rach
Up. Alarm went off like it had a grudge
slept. woke up at 8 and the grey was still there waiting for me
Did you eat
not yet. might walk to the shop. the one with the sad sandwiches
Good. Shop counts
you said that about the shower
Shop counts more
Break. Still no Thursday news on my end obviously, is it still the 9:20 thing
yeah. they said it's a phone call not a face one. so i don't have to look at anyone
that's probably the best thing anyone's said to me all week
went out. it's still grey. the bakery on the corner has a dog in the window that's the only good thing in bristol today
Send a photo of the dog
[photo: a scruffy brown dog asleep on a folded tea towel in a bakery window, a tray of buns behind him]
he's not mine
Obviously
Service tonight so I'm in till late. Phone's in my back pocket still, no promises on answering quick
ok
did you tell lou about the box thing

No

I wouldn't tell anyone without asking you first
ok. don't yet
Won't
Off. Feet are gone again
you said that yesterday

Still true

did you eat tonight
crackers. the ones from the cupboard that have been there since august

Good

They'll have gone soft but they count
Morning. Up?
sort of. lying in the bit of sun that comes through the gap in the curtain
it's the only sun in bristol so im not moving

Fair

did you sleep
about 5 hours in bits

Ok

Prep again. Chef's on one this morning, everyone's walking on eggshells
the school extension drawing is due friday. i've been staring at one line on the first floor plan since monday
its not even a hard line
Can you ask James for till Monday
i'm not sending james a mess
Tell him it's not right yet. Don't tell him why
ill's not a thing i can keep saying. he'll ask
Then say you're not right and you'd rather get it right than get it in. Nobody builds a school off a Friday
ok. i'll think about it
went to the shop. sad sandwich as predicted. ate half
Half counts
you're going to say that about everything
Yes
lou rang. asked if i fancied a drink thursday. i said i'd see
she didn't ask why i sounded like this which i think was her being nice

Break. Yeah, that sounds like her

You could go Friday instead. Or just for one
thursday i've got the call at 9.20 so i'd be wrecked after
friday maybe
Friday maybe is fine
Back on. Chef's gone home early so it's me and the dishwasher
the dog in the bakery is back. he's wearing a little coat now
No
[photo: a scruffy brown dog in a red knitted coat, asleep on the same folded tea towel]
he's fine. he's dog
He looks furious about it
he's not furious he's dignified
Service in an hour. Phone's in my back pocket, same as last night
ok
got up and put the lamp on properly. the room looks better with it on. not fixed. just not the colour of the sky

Good

Lamps count
you're just saying that

Off. Sorry, it was a bad one

You ok?
ok. not great. in bed. the grey's still in here but it's quieter

Ok

Phone's on. Sleep if you can
